name: long_document_processor
description: Optimized for processing very long documents (10k+ words)

steps.name: section_summaries
steps.prompt: Summarize this section of the document. Focus on: 1) Main topic/purpose, 2) Key facts and dates, 3) Important people mentioned, 4) Decisions or outcomes.

steps.name: comprehensive_summary
steps.prompt: Based on these section summaries, create a comprehensive summary of the entire document. Organize by themes and maintain chronological order where relevant.

steps.name: document_outline
steps.prompt: Create a detailed outline of this document with main sections and subsections. Return as JSON with nested structure.

steps.name: key_quotes
steps.prompt: Extract the most important quotes or passages from this section. Include context for each quote.
